I do think that this is an appropriate base for an HI-format, and wouldn't be adverse to this receiving the appropriate tag and such. It's distinct enough from the other formats- for me, at least- and I feel like future works could expand on1 it if need be.

Footnotes
1. For example, by having some context regarding who is doing the 'searching' and/or why. This could be internal communications between members, 'highlighted' text or notes scrawled off to the side, etc.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
As I said back in Saint Sophia, this could be the start of the Horizon Initiative GoI format. While it might be similar to the Cogwork Church format (in terms of the use of religious documents), this also uses a search engine to provide a more holistic view beyond individual excerpts.

I suppose that if we can adapt the style to broader contexts (since the current two are fairly tied to the Mekhanist-Sarkic lore), we should be able to see the full extent of the style.
